Under the general direction of the Physical Plant Building and Utility Services Carpenter Shop Supervisor, the Carpenter independently performs skilled journey-level carpentry work in support of the maintenance, repair, renovation, and construction of University buildings, infrastructure, and related facilities throughout the campus. The incumbent provides preventative and corrective maintenance on structural and architectural building components, including walls, roofs, floors, doors, windows, ceilings, cabinetry, and building hardware, while ensuring compliance with applicable building codes, safety standards, and University policies. The Carpenter performs rough and finish carpentry for remodeling, tenant improvements, emergency repairs, and new construction projects; fabricates and installs custom woodwork, millwork, cabinetry, shelving, seismic bracing, and other specialty building components; analyzes building envelopes to identify water intrusion and structural deficiencies; and recommends and implements appropriate repair solutions. Working from blueprints, specifications, sketches, and work orders, the incumbent selects appropriate construction methods and materials to complete projects safely, efficiently, and with a high level of craftsmanship. The Carpenter coordinates work activities with campus architects, inspectors, contractors, vendors, project managers, and other skilled trades to support complex maintenance and construction projects while minimizing disruption to campus operations. The incumbent operates and maintains a variety of woodworking equipment, power tools, construction equipment, and University vehicles; performs routine safety inspections and maintenance of shop equipment; assists in maintaining shop inventory; and responds to emergency repairs, preventative maintenance programs, and campus service requests. The Carpenter routinely works in occupied buildings, laboratories, residential, academic, administrative facilities, and other spaces requiring sound judgment, effective communication, technical expertise, and a strong commitment to safety and customer service.
